faq.q: What is included in the sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and a selection of drinks: cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. You also get light Spanish tapas (olives, cured meats, cheeses, bread). Champagne is served on arrival. All prices include 21% IVA.

faq.q: How much does a sunset cruise cost in Marbella?
faq.a: Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, covering up to 11 guests. For a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, and includes a free jet ski. Other yachts are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Where does the sunset cruise depart from?
faq.a: All our sunset cruises depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. You'll meet the skipper at the designated berth, typically 15 minutes before departure. Free parking is available nearby, or you can arrive by taxi from Marbella centre (10 minutes).

faq.q: What time does the sunset cruise start?
faq.a: Departure times vary by season. In summer (June–September), sunset is around 21:00–21:30, so we suggest boarding at 19:30–20:00. In spring and autumn, sunset is earlier (18:00–20:00). We'll confirm the exact time when you book, based on the day's sunset.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or drinks?
faq.a: The charter includes a generous selection of drinks and tapas, so you don't need to bring anything. However, you're welcome to bring your own snacks or a cake for a special occasion. Glass bottles are discouraged for safety – we provide plastic cups.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Your safety is our priority. If the captain deems conditions unsafe (high winds, thunderstorms), we'll reschedule your cruise at no extra cost or issue a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will contact you 24–48 hours before departure if needed.

faq.q: Is the sunset cruise suitable for children?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome on all our boats. Life jackets are provided for all ages. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 have shaded areas and a small cabin, which is handy if kids need a break from the sun. We recommend booking a longer charter (3–4 hours) for families.

faq.q: Can we extend the cruise to see the Marbella coastline?
faq.a: Absolutely. While the standard sunset cruise stays near Puerto Banús and the Golden Mile, you can upgrade to a 3- or 4-hour charter to cruise past Cabopino, Cala del Faro, or even Estepona. Contact us via WhatsApp to customise your route.

data.body_html:
Imagine gliding across the Mediterranean as the sun melts into the sea, a glass of chilled cava in hand, and a plate of Spanish tapas within reach. That's exactly what you get on a sunset cruise with champagne and tapas in Marbella 2039. Departing from Puerto Banús, this experience combines luxury, relaxation, and the region's best coastal views. Prices start at €749 for two hours on a private yacht, including skipper, drinks, and snacks. Whether you're celebrating an anniversary, proposing, or simply unwinding, this is Marbella at its finest.

Our fleet is based in Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's yachting scene. You'll board a modern motor yacht like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, both capable of carrying up to 11 guests. Every charter includes a professional skipper, fuel, insurance, and a curated selection of drinks: champagne on arrival, cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. A platter of Spanish tapas (olives, jamón, cheeses, bread) keeps hunger at bay. The 21% IVA is included, so there are no surprises.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise with Champagne & Tapas in Marbella?

A sunset cruise is the most memorable way to see Marbella's coastline. Unlike a day charter, the evening light softens the landscape, painting the Sierra Blanca mountains in gold and pink. You'll pass the iconic La Concha peak, the luxury villas of the Golden Mile, and the rocky coves of Cala del Faro. The sea is calmer, the air cooler, and the vibe is pure sophistication.

Champagne and tapas elevate the experience. The bubbly sets a celebratory tone, while the tapas reflect Andalusia's culinary heritage. It's a pairing that works whether you're with your partner, a group of friends, or family. Plus, you have the boat to yourselves – no crowds, no schedules, just your private party on the water.

Our Yachts for Sunset Cruises

We offer two main options for sunset charters, depending on your group size and budget. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include the same premium inclusions.

For a larger group or a longer experience, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4 hours) includes a free jet ski and offers more deck space. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, tapas, and IVA. For other yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Azimut 58, request a quote via WhatsApp.

What to Expect on Your Sunset Cruise

Your cruise begins at Puerto Banús. After a quick welcome from the skipper, you'll step aboard and be handed a glass of champagne. As you motor out of the marina, the skipper will point out landmarks – the luxury boutiques, the superyachts, the Andalusian hills. Within 15 minutes, you're in open water, heading west towards Estepona or east towards Cabopino, depending on the wind and your preference.

Around 30 minutes before sunset, the skipper will anchor in a sheltered bay – often Cala Cortés or off the coast of the Golden Mile. Here, you can take a dip in the warm sea, snap photos, or simply lounge on the deck. The tapas are served, and the drinks keep flowing. As the sun dips below the horizon, the sky turns shades of orange, red, and purple. It's a moment you'll remember long after you're back on land.

Best Time of Year for a Sunset Cruise in Marbella

The sunset cruise season runs from April to October, with the most spectacular sunsets occurring between June and September. In July and August, the sun sets around 21:30, giving you a long, languid evening. Spring and autumn offer milder temperatures and fewer crowds, with sunsets between 18:00 and 20:00. Even in winter, a sunset cruise is possible on clear days – just bring a jacket. The water temperature in summer reaches 24–26°C, perfect for a swim.

How to Book Your Sunset Cruise with Champagne & Tapas

Booking is straightforward. Choose your preferred yacht and time slot, then contact us via WhatsApp or the form on our website. We'll confirm availability, send you the meeting point details (usually berth A12 in Puerto Banús), and arrange payment. A 50% deposit secures your booking, with the balance due on the day. We recommend booking at least a week in advance, especially in July and August when slots fill quickly.

For a truly bespoke experience, let us know if you're celebrating a birthday, anniversary, or proposal. We can arrange a custom cake, flowers, or a photographer. Just ask.
